description: Source code implementing system path retrieval functions for a Linux environment, including functions to get cache, storage, executable, temporary, and content directories, with support for Evergreen configuration override.

methods.name: GetCacheDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the cache directory path based on the user's home directory.

methods.name: GetStorageDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the storage directory path based on the user's home directory.

methods.name: GetExecutablePath
methods.description: Gets the absolute path to the current executable.

methods.name: GetEvergreenContentPathOverride
methods.description: Overrides content path if an EvergreenConfig is present and specifies a custom content path.

methods.name: GetParentDirectory
methods.description: Modifies the given path to its parent directory.

methods.name: GetExecutableDirectory
methods.description: Gets the directory containing the current executable.

methods.name: GetExecutableName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of the current executable.

methods.name: GetTemporaryDirectory
methods.description: Creates a unique temporary directory path for the current process.

methods.name: GetContentDirectory
methods.description: Retrieves the content directory path relative to the executable.

methods.name: SbSystemGetPath
methods.description: Main function to get various system paths based on the provided path ID.
